config.title: Safe Appeals Audio
config.ffmpegPath: Absolute path to the ffmpeg binary (machine-scoped). Leave empty to use PATH.
config.ffprobePath: Absolute path to the ffprobe binary (machine-scoped). Leave empty to use PATH.
config.whisperModelPath: Leave empty for the SafeAppeals default Whisper model. Use Settings or Choose Different Whisper Model to override with another GGML .bin path. Changing models requires enough hardware for that model; accuracy and speed will vary. If the default is missing, run Install Default Whisper Model. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.defaultAudioExportFormat: Default format used when Export Audio is run without choosing a format (machine-scoped).
config.defaultTranscriptExportFormat: Default format used when Export Transcript is run without choosing a format (machine-scoped).
config.autoTranscribeOnSave: When enabled, automatically start transcription after a recording is saved, if Whisper and secure storage are available. Soft-fails with a notification if transcription cannot start (machine-scoped).
config.diarization.enabled: When on (default), automatically run speaker identification after transcription when the sherpa-onnx binary and models are available. Manual Identify Speakers still works when assets are present even if this is off. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.refine.enabled: When on (default), automatically run a local Whisper refine pass after speaker identification to improve wording using speaker labels as a cue. Manual Improve Transcript still works when this is off. Audio never leaves this computer. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.diarization.maxSpeakers: Expected number of speakers for clustering (1–4). Default 2. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.diarization.binaryPath: Absolute path to sherpa-onnx-offline-speaker-diarization. Leave empty to use managed app-data models/diarization/bin/ or the extension .spike-diarization/ layout when present. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.diarization.segmentationModelPath: Absolute path to the pyannote segmentation ONNX model. Leave empty for managed models/diarization/. Machine-scoped; not synced.
config.diarization.embeddingModelPath: Absolute path to the speaker embedding ONNX model (e.g. CAM++). Leave empty for managed models/diarization/. Machine-scoped; not synced.
